criteria.requirement: Implement click.dynamic.DynamicChoice(provider,*,case_sensitive=True) as ParamType. Provider accepts current Context or None and returns finite choices; snapshot once per conversion/help/completion operation and delegate actual normalization/identity/error behavior to Choice. Do not cache across calls or mutate provider results. Help metavars and shell completion must use current choices; metadata inspection must not eagerly call provider without context. Preserve original choice objects and provider exceptions, and verify independent CLI invocations with different ctx.obj values.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
